verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at 6.5 because its structured grid, restrained semantic color, and mostly steady registers feel deliberate, but visible routing waypoints and a substantial empty lower band keep it from reading as fully finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: Failing: the process fills the upper and middle regions coherently, but roughly the bottom quarter of the locked frame is entirely unused and creates a conspicuous dead band.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Red dashed lines consistently denote failures and blue dashed lines denote background rebuild work, while the yellow reading guide is clearly differentiated without decorative noise.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Failing: small square routing waypoints remain visible around the Fuse + rerank output and the evidence-decision branch, exposing connector machinery.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Major section frames follow clear horizontal registers and the three-tier density is intentional, though uneven panel widths and long exception-wire runs slightly disturb the rhythm.
